headline: Meta to create new stock class to fund its AI buildout
summary: Meta announced it will issue a new non-voting class of shares, with trading starting in 2027, to help fund its AI investments, acquisitions and employee compensation.

claims.statement: Meta is creating a new, non-voting class of shares to help fund its AI push.

sources.quote: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
Meta wants to pay for its broad AI buildout with a newly created class of stock

claims.statement: The new stock will also go toward potential acquisitions and employee compensation.

sources.quote: the company says the non-voting stock will also go toward potential acquisitions and employee compensation, with trading beginning in 2027.

claims.statement: Trading of the new shares is set to begin in 2027.
